sqf: if (!isNil 'CLAUDE_virtualizeLoop') then { terminate CLAUDE_virtualizeLoop; }; CLAUDE_virtualizeRange = 1500; CLAUDE_cacheRange = 2000; CLAUDE_cachedUnits = []; ['═══════════════════════════════════════'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; ['VIRTUALIZATION SYSTEM ONLINE'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; [format ['Active Range: %1m | Cache Range: %2m', CLAUDE_virtualizeRange, CLAUDE_cacheRange]] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; ['═══════════════════════════════════════'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; CLAUDE_virtualizeLoop = [] spawn { while {true} do { private _players = allPlayers; private _allAI = allUnits select { !isPlayer _x && alive _x && !(vehicle _x isKindOf 'Air') }; private _cached = 0; private _active = 0; { private _unit = _x; private _minDist = 999999; { _minDist = _minDist min (_unit distance _x); } forEach _players; if (_minDist > CLAUDE_cacheRange) then { if (simulationEnabled _unit) then { _unit enableSimulationGlobal false; _unit hideObjectGlobal true; CLAUDE_cachedUnits pushBackUnique _unit; _cached = _cached + 1; }; } else { if (!simulationEnabled _unit) then { _unit enableSimulationGlobal true; _unit hideObjectGlobal false; CLAUDE_cachedUnits = CLAUDE_cachedUnits - [_unit]; _active = _active + 1; }; }; } forEach _allAI; if (_cached > 0 || _active > 0) then { diag_log format ['[VIRTUALIZE] Cached: %1 | Reactivated: %2 | Total cached: %3', _cached, _active, count CLAUDE_cachedUnits]; }; sleep 5; }; }; private _farUnits = allUnits select { !isPlayer _x && alive _x && { private _u = _x; private _minD = 999999; { _minD = _minD min (_u distance _x) } forEach allPlayers; _minD > CLAUDE_cacheRange } }; { _x enableSimulationGlobal false; _x hideObjectGlobal true; CLAUDE_cachedUnits pushBackUnique _x; } forEach _farUnits; [format ['Initial cache: %1 units virtualized', count _farUnits]] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0]; ['System will update every 5 seconds.'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0];
